postings.title: Senior Genesys Cloud Engineer
postings.description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across five continents and operates in 25 countries worldwide. Miratech retains over 1000 full-time professionals and has achieved sustained shareholder value growth exceeding 25% annually over many years.

We are looking for a Senior Genesys Cloud Engineer to design, integrate, support, and optimize contact-center solutions. The role combines advanced platform expertise with customer-focused teamwork and flexible service conditions

Working Hours: This role requires close cooperation with the Spanish team during Spanish business hours, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Spain time (approximately 5:00 AM–1:00 PM Argentina time).

Language Requirements: Fluency in both Spanish and English is required.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, configure, and maintain Genesys Cloud CX solutions, ensuring alignment with technical and customer requirements.
  • Design and optimize interaction flows in Genesys Cloud Architect, including IVR, ACD, queues, bots, omnichannel interactions, callbacks, and social messaging.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud routing, including queues, skills, schedules, and routing rules.
  • Develop and maintain integrations with external systems using Genesys Cloud Platform APIs, webhooks, and Data Actions for REST/JSON APIs.
  • Develop and maintain Outbound Dialing configurations, including Predictive, Progressive, and Preview Campaigns, as well as recording and quality management capabilities.
  • Implement conversational automation using Dialog Engine Bot Flows and third-party bots through Bot Connector; configure Genesys Cloud analytics, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
  • Provide Level 2/3 technical support for incidents and service requests while collaborating with technical and business teams to deliver effective solutions.
  • 6+ years of experience designing, developing, configuring, and maintaining Genesys Cloud CX solutions.
  • English B2+ and Spanish C1+ proficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud Architect, including call, messaging, IVR, and bot flows.
  • Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud Platform APIs, including REST API integrations, queries, webhooks, and process automation.
  • Experience with Genesys Cloud Data Actions for integrating external REST/JSON APIs.
  • Experience configuring Genesys Cloud Outbound Dialing, including Predictive, Progressive, and Preview Campaigns.
  • Experience with Recording, Quality Management, Analytics, and Reporting, including recording configuration, tagging, quality assurance processes, dashboards, and Analytics APIs.

  • Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Genesys Dialog Engine Bot Flows and Bot Connector, including integrations with third-party bot platforms such as Google Dialogflow or AWS Lex.
  • Experience with Workforce Engagement Management (WEM), including schedules, skills, and workforce planning.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth. 
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program. 
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work. 
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities. 
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries. 
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events. 
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality. 

*Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

postings.description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. Miratech has coverage across five continents and operates in 25 countries worldwide. Miratech retains over 1000 full-time professionals and has achieved sustained shareholder value growth exceeding 25% annually over many years.

We are looking for a Senior Genesys Cloud Specialist to support Telephony Delivery, with a primary focus on two strategic areas: the integration and enhancement of the WhatsApp channel within the contact center platform and the development of new IVR functionalities.

The selected candidate will also contribute to cross-functional business initiatives, particularly in campaign and tooling rollouts for Marketing. Experience with Skill-Based Dialling (SBD) and Outbound Campaign Management in Genesys Cloud will be important for this role

Language Requirements: Fluency in both Spanish and English is required.

Responsibilities

  • Designing, configuring, and deploying IVR flows in Genesys Cloud Architect, including routing logic, customer identification and authentication, and pre-operator stages.
  • Leading the development and integration of the WhatsApp Business channel within Genesys Cloud, including templates, digital routing, and Business-Scoped User ID (BSUID) management.
  • Configuring and optimizing Outbound and Skill Based Dialling campaigns, including Fair Use compliance, dialling ratios, and agent-to-skill assignment.
  • Acting as a technical reference for Marketing rollout initiatives, including campaign assignment, predictive and progressive dialling, contact list management, and contactability.
  • Contributing to the evolution of Genesys Cloud integration architecture with internal applications using the Embeddable Framework, EventBridge, and APIs.
  • Providing functional and technical support for incidents and requests related to IVR, WhatsApp, and Outbound functionality.
  • Documenting solution designs, flows, and configurations and preparing technical deliverables, including manuals, diagrams, and test cases, in English and Spanish.
  • Defining and applying best practices, configuration standards, and test plans for new platform developments.
  • Collaborating with Genesys, system integrators, and other vendors on incident resolution and the evaluation of new platform features.
  • Working closely with Marketing, Operations, Development, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud CX in high-volume contact center environments.
  • Strong experience developing and configuring IVR flows with Genesys Cloud Architect; experience with Composer/ININ in Genesys OnPrem is also relevant.
  • Hands-on experience integrating WhatsApp Business API with contact center platforms.
  • Demonstrable expertise in Skill Based Dialling (SBD) and Outbound campaign management in Genesys Cloud, including Fair Use, dialling ratios, DNC lists, and contactability.
  • Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud REST APIs, Data Actions, and webhooks for third-party and internal system integrations.
  • Experience with digital channels, including chat and SMS, and digital routing/ACD configuration.
  • English B2+ and Spanish C1+ proficiency.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Speech and Text Analytics and contactability dashboards.
  • Knowledge of telephony regulatory frameworks, including STIR/SHAKEN, Ley SAC, and prefix regulations, as applied to IVR and Outbound solutions.
  • Official Genesys Cloud certifications, such as Genesys Cloud Certified Professional.
  • Experience with Genesys OnPrem to Genesys Cloud migration projects.
  • Knowledge of conversational AI or AIOps solutions for IVR and voicebots, such as ElevenLabs or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with large-scale contact centers in the security, alarms, or subscription services sectors.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth. 
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program. 
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work. 
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities. 
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries. 
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events. 
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

Miratech is looking for an experienced AWS Cloud Engineer – Platform Operations to support and optimize AWS infrastructure powering Amazon Connect and enterprise cloud platforms. This role combines AWS Cloud Operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Automation, and Observability to deliver highly available, secure, and scalable cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with AWS services, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, cloud automation, production support, and observability across enterprise environments.

  • Support and enhance AWS infrastructure for Amazon Connect and related platform services.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and automate operational tasks using Python and AWS CLI.
  • Improve platform reliability by supporting incident response, RCA, disaster recovery, and production readiness activities.

  • Develop dashboards, alerts, and monitoring solutions using CloudWatch, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, and release management activities.
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to improve cloud scalability, security, and operational excellence.
  • 5+ years of experience in AWS Cloud Operations, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC, Route 53, S3, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, and DynamoDB.
  • Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience with Python, AWS CLI, PowerShell, or similar automation tools.
  • Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, CloudWatch, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

The role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues using observability tools such as Splunk and Zabbix.

This role offers the opportunity to develop broad expertise across multiple leading CCaaS platforms in a modern enterprise contact center environment.

  • Develop and maintain CloudWatch dashboards as a complementary monitoring solution to ensure redundancy and visibility.
  • 4+ years of overall IT experience with strong exposure to CCaaS environments.
  • Solid experience in contact center observability, monitoring, and troubleshooting of production systems.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk and CloudWatch.
  • Practical AWS cloud experience, including Lambda, Amazon Connect, Application Load Balancers (ALBs).
